source: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Agricultural Research Service. FoodData Central, SR Legacy, final April 2018 release.
nutrient_basis: Per 100 g, copied directly from source nutrient IDs 1008 (kcal), 1003 (protein), 1005 (carbohydrate), and 1004 (fat). Source calorie values are preserved; they are not recalculated from macros.
labels: The 94 existing Arabic names, IDs, aliases and serving descriptions are preserved in food-catalog-labels.json. Added foods keep exact English source descriptions. Arabic aliases are curated search keywords in Scripts/import_usda_catalog.py, not complete translations or new recipe identities.
scope: This is an open USDA catalog, separate from online Open Food Facts branded product results. It is not the MyFitnessPal database. Photo recognition reference foods are maintained separately.
